frozen_formula_source.formula: cond2(weight-balanced Schur) times (relative long-double 2-norm residual plus eps64) times max_abs(u_h)
frozen_formula_source.exterior_relative_l2_floor: absolute forward-error floor divided by the exterior reference RMS

defect.description: The trace floor multiplied the frozen forward-error floor by a route-dependent evaluator norm and used a different residual normalization. The evaluator multiplier was not part of the frozen predecessor and was not an end-to-end bound for the Schur correction map.
defect.materiality: The unequal multiplier obscured the high-order BMC trace advantage and made the strongest-comparator factors indeterminate.
defect.checkpoint_policy: The completed defective-floor matrix is preserved as superseded diagnostic evidence and excluded from ranking. No checkpoint was reused.

scientific_consequence: The corrected floor certifies BMC9 worst-shift exact compact-over-BMC factors of 62.707527291670914 for wall trace and 32.16591996072041 for exterior relative L2. The composite verdict remains reject_compact_wall_advantage because BMC9 costs 1.699800439571433 and 1.7582010277920994 times its C10 plus L12 blockers and lacks a four-grid above-floor order receipt.
